text: きろくが　おわれば　でんげんを　きっても　だいじょうぶです！

structure.jp: きろくが　おわれば
でんげんを　きっても
structure.en: even if you turn off the power

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending on a verb means 'if' or 'once' that happens. おわれば = 'once it is finished'.

patterns.name: 〜てもいい
patterns.span: きっても　だいじょうぶ
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus も and a word for 'fine' says it is okay to do that; here だいじょうぶ stands in for いい. きっても　だいじょうぶ = 'it's fine to turn it off'.
